method: Headless Chrome 1920x1080 on the work Mac: load, mouse drags/flings, squash, CDP touch drag, reset/toggle/restart clicks, keyboard thrust; MP4s: ffprobe, 12 frames each, volumedetect. Scores are subjective 1-5 against the prompt; not the certified pass/fail.
caveats: Look scores are subjective 1–5 reviews, not automated passes. Missing deliverables count as 0 in the six-test mean.
Strict pass includes README. Excluding README is shown separately; a playable artifact can still fail strict checks.
GLM ×2 and ×3 are different builds; GLM ×3 and ×4 use EXL3. Four-Spark runs used the direct-cable ring, not the switch.
DeepSeek is the 128k rerun. The confounded 1M-default run and coached Qwen continuation are excluded.
Wall time is generation time, not playback/rendering time. Some four-Spark per-task wall times were not recorded.
